title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十一章、太后的警告

    在太后的宫里，包拯见到了太后。
    太后问包拯：“八王爷被绑架的事情和李妃有什么关系？”
    包拯回答道：“绑架八王爷的人留了一件首饰给我，首饰的主人是一个名叫楚珠的宫女。楚珠是二十一年前李妃宫里的下人。绑匪先绑架八王爷，再用首饰引出楚珠和李妃。我想绑匪的真正目的不是八王爷，而是二十一年前的旧事，他想借我的手查案。”
    “我听明白了。包拯，你认为劫匪要查的二十一年前的旧事是指什么？”
    包拯看着太后的眼睛，他有点儿不忍心，但他还是要问：“太后，您相信当年李妃生下来的真的是一只狸猫吗？”
    太后的神色起了变化，她有点儿紧张，当年的事情对她来说也许真的是一种惊吓。
    “大胆！来人啊！立刻把包拯拖出去！”张怀生气地大叫。
    “太后，请您回答！”包拯追问。
    尊贵的太后显然没有遇到过像包拯这样大胆的人，她没有回答，她有点儿措手不及。两名侍卫冲了进来，抓住包拯往外拖。就在包拯快被拖出大门的时候，太后终于说话了：“等等。”她坐直了身子，慢慢说道，“包拯，李妃生产的过程，内班院都有记录，你可以去内班院查记录。当年我受了惊吓，先皇不让宫里的人和我说李妃的事情，所以我知道的也不多，内班院的记录会更详细。”
    太后的紧张消失了，刚刚的措手不及好像只是一阵快速吹过的风。现在，深海重回平静，海面上一点儿风浪都没有了。
    “我知道了，谢太后。”包拯弯腰说道。
    “但是——”太后的声音高了些，“李妃的事情你只能查到这儿，不能再深挖。现在国家安定，皇帝也做得很好，我不希望这种好局面被以前的事情影响。无论绑匪的目的是什么，无论他们绑架了谁，你都不能再查了。”
    “可是八王爷是皇上的父亲，我们不能……”包拯疑惑地说，但他没有说完就被太后打断了——
    “不，包拯，你记住，皇上是我的儿子，他的父亲是先皇。”
    包拯吃惊地望向太后，太后的眼里满是警告的意味。没错，是警告。但警告有时候也是接近真相的一种标志，因为害怕或是为了保护，才会发出警告。太后是在害怕被包拯查到什么，还是在保护皇帝呢？
    包拯没有说话，他弯腰向太后行了个礼，然后离开了。
fullText.traditional:
第十一章、太后的警告

    在太后的宮裡，包拯見到了太后。
    太后問包拯：“八王爺被綁架的事情和李妃有什麼關係？”
    包拯回答道：“綁架八王爺的人留了一件首飾給我，首飾的主人是一個名叫楚珠的宮女。楚珠是二十一年前李妃宮裡的下人。綁匪先綁架八王爺，再用首飾引出楚珠和李妃。我想綁匪的真正目的不是八王爺，而是二十一年前的舊事，他想借我的手查案。”
    “我聽明白了。包拯，你認為劫匪要查的二十一年前的舊事是指什麼？”
    包拯看著太后的眼睛，他有點兒不忍心，但他還是要問：“太后，您相信當年李妃生下來的真的是一隻狸貓嗎？”
    太后的神色起了變化，她有點兒緊張，當年的事情對她來說也許真的是一種驚嚇。
    “大膽！來人啊！立刻把包拯拖出去！”張懷生氣地大叫。
    “太后，請您回答！”包拯追問。
    尊貴的太后顯然沒有遇到過像包拯這樣大膽的人，她沒有回答，她有點兒措手不及。兩名侍衛衝了進來，抓住包拯往外拖。就在包拯快被拖出大門的時候，太后終於說話了：“等等。”她坐直了身子，慢慢說道，“包拯，李妃生產的過程，內班院都有記錄，你可以去內班院查記錄。當年我受了驚嚇，先皇不讓宮裡的人和我說李妃的事情，所以我知道的也不多，內班院的記錄會更詳細。”
    太后的緊張消失了，剛剛的措手不及好像只是一陣快速吹過的風。現在，深海重回平靜，海面上一點兒風浪都沒有了。
    “我知道了，謝太后。”包拯彎腰說道。
    “但是——”太后的聲音高了些，“李妃的事情你只能查到這兒，不能再深挖。現在國家安定，皇帝也做得很好，我不希望這種好局面被以前的事情影響。無論綁匪的目的是什麼，無論他們綁架了誰，你都不能再查了。”
    “可是八王爺是皇上的父親，我們不能……”包拯疑惑地說，但他沒有說完就被太后打斷了——
    “不，包拯，你記住，皇上是我的兒子，他的父親是先皇。”
    包拯吃驚地望向太后，太后的眼裡滿是警告的意味。沒錯，是警告。但警告有時候也是接近真相的一種標誌，因為害怕或是為了保護，才會發出警告。太后是在害怕被包拯查到什麼，還是在保護皇帝呢？
    包拯沒有說話，他彎腰向太后行了個禮，然後離開了。

sentences.simplified: 但警告有时候也是接近真相的一种标志，因为害怕或是为了保护，才会发出警告。
sentences.traditional: 但警告有時候也是接近真相的一種標誌，因為害怕或是為了保護，才會發出警告。
sentences.pinyin: dàn jǐng gào yǒu shí hou yě shì jiē jìn zhēn xiàng de yì zhǒng biāo zhì yīn wèi hài pà huò shì wèi le bǎo hù cái huì fā chū jǐng gào
sentences.english: But sometimes a warning is also a sign that you’re getting close to the truth because warnings are prompted by fear or the need to protect.

sentences.simplified: 太后是在害怕被包拯查到什么，还是在保护皇帝呢？
sentences.traditional: 太后是在害怕被包拯查到什麼，還是在保護皇帝呢？
sentences.pinyin: tài hòu shì zài hài pà bèi bāo zhěng chá dào shén me hái shi zài bǎo hù huáng dì ne
sentences.english: Was the empress dowager afraid of Bao Zheng discovering something, or was she protecting the emperor?

sentences.simplified: 包拯没有说话，他弯腰向太后行了个礼，然后离开了。
sentences.traditional: 包拯沒有說話，他彎腰向太后行了個禮，然後離開了。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng méi yǒu shuō huà tā wān yāo xiàng tài hòu xíng le ge lǐ rán hòu lí kāi le
sentences.english: Bao Zheng did not speak. He bowed to the empress dowager and then left.

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: The Empress Dowager’s Warning
Bao Zheng met the empress dowager in the empress dowager’s palace.
The empress dowager asked Bao Zheng, “What does the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince have to do with Consort Li?”
Bao Zheng replied, “The person who kidnapped the Eighth Prince left a piece of jewelry for me.
The owner of the jewelry was a palace maid named Chu Zhu.
Chu Zhu was a servant in Consort Li’s palace twenty-one years ago.
The kidnappers first kidnapped the Eighth Prince, and then used jewelry to draw out Chu Zhu and Consort Li.
I think the kidnapper’s real target is not the Eighth Prince, but rather the events from twenty-one years ago.
He wants to use me to investigate the case.”
“I understand now.
Bao Zheng, what do you think the past events from twenty-one years ago that the kidnapper wants to investigate are referring to?
Bao Zheng looked into the empress dowager’s eyes. He was quite reluctant, but he still had to ask, ..
.. “Empress Dowager, do you really believe that Consort Li gave birth to a leopard cat all those years ago?”
The empress dowager’s expression changed. She seemed a little nervous. Perhaps the events of that year were truly a shock to her.
“How dare you! Someone, come here! Drag Bao Zheng out right now!” Zhang Huai shouted angrily.
“Empress Dowager, please answer!” Bao Zheng pursued the question.
The esteemed empress dowager had clearly never encountered someone as bold as Bao Zheng.
She did not respond. She was somewhat caught off guard.
Two imperial guards rushed in and grabbed Bao Zheng to drag him out.
Just as Bao Zheng was about to be dragged out of the gate, the empress dowager finally spoke: “Wait.”
She sat up straight and slowly said, ..
.. “Bao Zheng, the process of Consort Li’s childbirth is all recorded in the Department of Inner Palace Affairs.
You can go to the Department of Inner Palace Affairs to check the records.
I was frightened back then, and the late emperor did not allow anyone in the palace to talk to me about Consort Li, so I don’t know much.
The records in the Department of Inner Palace Affairs will be more detailed.”
The empress dowager’s anxiety disappeared, ..
.. and the earlier moment of being caught off guard seemed like a gust of wind that had quickly passed.
Now, the deep sea had returned to calmness, and there was not a single ripple on the surface.
“I understand, thank you Empress Dowager,” Bao Zheng bowed and said.
“But––” the empress dowager’s voice rose a bit, “You can only investigate Consort Li up to this point. You must not dig any deeper.
Right now the country is stable, and the emperor is doing a good job. I don’t want this good situation to be affected by past events.
No matter what the kidnappers’ purpose is, no matter who they have kidnapped, you must not investigate any further.”
“But the Eighth Prince is the emperor’s father, we can’t …” Bao Zheng said uncertainly, ..
.. but he was interrupted by the empress dowager before he could finish––
“No, Bao Zheng. Remember, the emperor is my son. His father is the late emperor.”
Bao Zheng looked at the empress dowager in shock. Her eyes were filled with a warning. Yes, it was a warning.
But sometimes a warning is also a sign that you’re getting close to the truth because warnings are prompted by fear or the need to protect.
Was the empress dowager afraid of Bao Zheng discovering something, or was she protecting the emperor?
Bao Zheng did not speak. He bowed to the empress dowager and then left.
